name: rust-quality
description: Implement Rust features with explicit invariants, TDD and deep-module design, and set up the cargo quality gates (lints, cargo-deny layering bans, xtask verify) that enforce the mechanical rules.

interface.shortDescription: High-assurance Rust features: invariants first, then TDD, verify and adversarial review.
interface.longDescription: Two skills: rust-quality-setup moves every machine-checkable rule into cargo config (workspace lints, clippy.toml, cargo-deny bans for crate layering, a std-only cargo xtask verify/mutants), and rust-feature runs each feature through explicit invariants, deep-module design, TDD at agreed seams, the verify matrix and an adversarial review.
defaultPrompt: Use Rust Quality to set up lints and xtask verify in this workspace.
Use Rust Quality to implement this feature with explicit invariants.
